zh.title: 瑞安航空與西南航空波音737機隊營運效率對比分析
zh.summary: 瑞安航空與西南航空對比737客機營運效率；歐洲航班單日飛行逾12小時
body: 《Aerospace Global News》針對歐洲瑞安航空（Ryanair）與美國西南航空（Southwest Airlines）旗下兩架機齡同為7.9年的波音（Boeing）737-800客機進行營運追蹤，以比較大西洋兩岸低成本航空在夏季高峰期的航機利用率。兩架客機均於2018年交付並配備CFM56發動機，其中瑞安航空客機採189座單一經濟艙配置，西南航空客機則配置175座。
追蹤數據顯示，在2026年8月3日的營運中，瑞安航空註冊號EI-GSH的客機共執行7個航段，總飛行時間達12小時37分鐘，飛行距離為5,323海里；西南航空註冊號N8582Z的客機同日亦執行7個航段，總飛行時間為9小時34分鐘，飛行距離則為4,144海里。

en.title: Ryanair and Southwest Boeing 737-800 Flight Operations Compared in Tracking Study
en.summary: Ryanair and Southwest Airlines Boeing 737-800 flight operations were tracked to compare summer aircraft utilization.
body: Aerospace Global News tracked flight operations for two Boeing 737-800 aircraft operated by Ryanair and Southwest Airlines during the peak summer season to compare transatlantic fleet utilization. Both aircraft were delivered in September 2018 and are equipped with CFM56 engines, with Ryanair's aircraft configured for 189 passengers in an all-economy cabin and Southwest's configured for 175 seats.

On August 3, 2026, Ryanair's aircraft (EI-GSH) operated seven flight sectors totaling 12 hou (HOU)rs and 37 minutes of flight time across 5,323 nautical miles. On the same day, Southwest Airlines' aircraft (N8582Z) also completed seven sectors, logging nine hours and 34 minutes of flight time across 4,144 nautical miles.

facts.claim: Aerospace Global News tracked Boeing 737-800 aircraft operated by Ryanair and Southwest Airlines over seven days to compare utilization across Europe and North America.
facts.sourceQuote: We tracked two near-identical Boeing 737-800s for seven days during the peak summer travel season: one operated by Ryanair across Europe, the other by Southwest Airlines across North America.

facts.claim: Ryanair's Boeing 737-800 is configured for 189 passengers in an all-economy cabin, while Southwest's is configured for 175 passengers.
facts.sourceQuote: It is configured to accommodate 189 passengers in a single-class, all-economy layout.

facts.claim: On August 3, 2026, Ryanair's aircraft operated seven sectors and flew for 12 hours and 37 minutes, covering 5,323 nautical miles.
facts.sourceQuote: In all, the aircraft operated seven sectors and flew for 12 hours and 37 minutes, covering 5,323 nautical miles (nm), with an average sector length of 761 nm.

facts.claim: On the same day, Southwest's aircraft operated seven sectors and flew for nine hours and 34 minutes, covering 4,144 nautical miles.
